atAGlance: Chả lụa is Vietnamese steamed pork sausage, usually with smooth slices, pepper, banana-leaf aroma, and rice or bánh mì.
whatItIs: Chả lụa is smooth steamed Vietnamese pork sausage wrapped in banana leaf. It is mild, springy, and often sliced into bánh mì, bánh cuốn, xôi, or rice plates.
usuallyIncludes: slices for bánh mì or rice
howToEnjoy: Eat it sliced with rice, sticky rice, bánh cuốn, or inside bánh mì. The banana-leaf aroma and smooth bounce are the point.
howLocalsOrder: Order chả lụa when you want the mild pork sausage side or filling. Ask for it sliced, added to bánh mì, or served with bánh cuốn depending on the shop.
worthKnowing: Chả lụa is a building-block food in Vietnam; recognizing it helps decode many breakfast and snack plates.
